messages:
jordan (pm): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few concrete timeline/questions so product + eng can align before next sprint. posting here so folks can chime in.

jordan (pm): 1) GA windows for the console UI changes (bulk-routing, per-model dashboards) — you said 'Q2-ish' in the talk. can we call out a narrower window and release owners?

jordan (pm): 2) Optimize feature: will the intelligent batching suggestions be in the hosted console first or behind Dedicated/Private? recommended rollout order?

jordan (pm): 3) API compatibility: any breaking SDK changes customers should plan for when we flip the new rate-limiting defaults?

kevin (cto): short answers — will expand.
kevin (cto): 1) Console UI GA target: end of next month for beta -> internal canary, GA ~6 weeks after canary depending on feedback. owners: @sara (product) lead, @aj (eng) infra lead.

kevin (cto): 2) Optimize: hosted console first. we want suggestions available to self-serve customers to drive usage before Dedicated integrations. Private will follow with a light-weight agent in the next quarter.

kevin (cto): 3) SDK: no breaking API surface changes planned. rate-limit defaults will change behavior for bursty customers — we're adding a migration flag to opt into the new behavior first.

sara (product): adding details on owners and concrete checkpoints.
sara (product): Console beta rollout (feature-flagged) -> date: 2540250000 (internal canary). GA gating criteria: no P0 UX regressions, <2% error delta on dashboard queries, and a performance SLO of <200ms median render for common pages.

sara (product): Owners: Console PM: jordan (pm) (design + acceptance), Eng lead: aj (eng) (infra + rollout), QE: we'll assign next week. Action: I'll post a short checklist in #product by EOD.

aj (eng): infra notes — canary plan and fallback knobs.
aj (eng): Canary will run in us-west-2 with 5% traffic on dedicated web nodes. if latency or error rate spike > 5x baseline we'll auto-rollback.

aj (eng): rollout config snippet (will be in the repo):
```
rollout:
  phase1: 5%
  phase2: 25%
  phase3: 100%
  rollback_on:
    - error_rate > 5x
    - median_latency > 2x
```

aj (eng): Also adding a runtime toggle so customers won't see the new per-model dashboard until they opt in from the org settings — helps avoid surprise.

lina (devex): SDK & docs plan: we'll add a clear migration guide for the rate-limit default flip and a code sample for the migration flag. Docs PR ready by 2540200000, SDK patch release the same week.

lina (devex): I'll coordinate with @aj (eng) for the example config and with @sara (product) for acceptance text.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary job started for console-ui feature-flag at 2539880005 — routing 5% of user sessions to canary cluster.

sara (product): perfect. Jordan/aj/lina — can each of you drop your top 2 risks in this thread by EOD? I'll consolidate and share with leadership tomorrow.

jordan (pm): risk1: UX flow around model switching may need extra polish. risk2: telemetry gaps for per-route cost attribution.

aj (eng): risk1: KV-cache eviction interactions with new dashboard cached queries. risk2: autoscaler ramp for console metrics backend under burst.

lina (devex): risk1: docs lag causing confusion for early adopters. risk2: SDK bundling edge-case on older node versions.

kevin (cto): thanks all. I'll be watching the canary metrics and will jump in if we see regressions. Sara — please ping me after you consolidate risks.

sara (product): will do. next steps: i'll post the checklist, owners, and a compact timeline in #product; QA owner assignment by Thursday; we aim for GA decision 6 weeks after canary. :thumbsup: 

jordan (pm): thanks — appreciate the quick sync. :rocket:
